name: research-skills-openai
description: Scientific research workflows and independent review for the OpenAI ecosystem.

interface.shortDescription: Research development and independent scientific review
interface.longDescription: Develop research ideas, proposals, articles, Perspectives, and improvements to existing studies. Includes independent scientific review, methodology consultation, medical journal review, and statistical analysis planning. Uses the tools available in the OpenAI environment for general capabilities. An experimental personal project.
defaultPrompt: Develop and compare evidence-grounded research ideas.
Develop a research proposal or manuscript with independent scientific review.
Compare worthwhile improvements to an existing study and their costs.
